goal: Test whether early evolvable-assurance relative preservation of I requires visitor presence using new visitor histories and new diploid founder genomes.

factorization.visitor_removal: All native visitor state arrays replaced by truly empty VisitorState from update0; original source seed candidate history and all plant config unchanged.
factorization.pair_matching: For any history×founder×setting, both visitor regimes and both A policies restart the same original parental lottery, segregation and mutation random streams using source SeedSequence([new visitor seed, new demographic seed]) followed by unchanged stream(...)

primary_contrasts.unit: 64 independently seeded visitor/demography clusters; within each cluster average the two paired, fixed founder backgrounds; do not count 2 founder x four mating rules as new visitor histories
primary_contrasts.estimand: For each mating rule, [I200_evolvable-I200_fixed] with native far visitors, minus the same with all visitors absent from t0.
primary_contrasts.interpretation: If consistently nonzero, visit availability changes the model-specific A-evolvability effect on I. This is a causal intervention on synthetic visitor histories only, not an identified natural-island mediation or unique drift mechanism.
primary_contrasts.reporting: Report exact interaction per mating rule and fourfold family of two-sided 98.75% history-cluster bootstrap percentile intervals (4096 resamples fixed seed 20261015), plus all signs and full null findings.
primary_contrasts.control: Original-shared t0 founder genotypes equal in all four treatments; A-fixed retains autonomous selfing at A=0.5; no pollen local gradient remains -2*c_I*I, not zero.
primary_contrasts.holdout_reporting: Report 63 source-new visitor seeds 28110602..28110664 separately as primary full-campaign descriptive readout because seed28110601 had an outcome-visible technical pilot. Also report original registered all64, retaining it exactly.
primary_contrasts.original_preregistered_64_unit: Keep unchanged original 64 visitor-history contrast and fourfold Bonferroni 98.75% CI. The 63-history view is a transparent postpilot restriction, not a second preregistered hypothesis test.

outcomes: E-F I levels at t50, t100, t200 by visitor regime
total 0–200 parental Price and realized newborn residual difference within each intervention
actual no-visitor exposure in original far, finite N and occupancy
secondary.scope: Post-original-model-target exploratory; secondary intervals descriptive without promotion to independent law.

scope_guards: Use strictly new visitor history seeds 28110601..28110664 (not the already-inspected 26110601..26110664).
Use distinct founder seeds 28111601, 28111602; independently drawn starting genomes are shared within matched 2x2 and across mating settings for each background.
Use unchanged original-genome birth, sex-specific reproduction, diploid segregation, density and mutation operators.
When any treatment extinct by t200, retain its occupancy and mark I contrast undefined; do not exclude that history to force a sign.
No original-model parameter tuning, no posthoc stopping for significance, no generated biological histories beyond registered 2048.
Technical pilot is not a science confirmation and must not be silently pooled as extra independent data.
stop_conditions: Source archive/manifests or expected config mismatch
Any paired common-random stream or frozen-visitor intervention contract mismatch
Original no-mutation fixed-vs-evolving technical parity fails
Total futures <2048, or any missing history or founder cell
Any phenotype out of [0,1], duplicate parent IDs, or non-telescoping per-year I response
Refuse to publish a single sign as new law if Bonferroni fourfold interaction 98.75% cluster intervals do not exclude zero.
scientific_priority: Far-side asymmetry is a secondary unresolved Model3 mechanism; Q2 and Q3 remain the proposed Letter core, Q1 is existing-theory context, Q4 separately scoped.

technical_pilot_after_original_design_fr.interpretation: Exclude this already inspected seed from the primary descriptive confirmation view of the remaining 63 seeds, and also present the original full 64 design without duplicate counting. This prospective-to-full-histories amendment does not change effects, source kernels, settings, seed selection, or original outcomes.
